title: 10-Day Central Turkey Tour: Cappadocia to Didyma
metaDescription: Travel from Istanbul and Cappadocia to Pamukkale, Ephesus and Didyma on a 10-day journey connecting central Turkey with the ancient Aegean.

10-Day Central Turkey Tour: Cappadocia to Didyma
summary:
The 10-Day Central Turkey Tour: Cappadocia to Didyma crosses Turkey from Istanbul and the landscapes of Cappadocia to some of the Aegean region’s most important ancient sites. After exploring Cappadocia’s valleys, fairy chimneys and underground cities, travel west to Pamukkale and Hierapolis before continuing to Ephesus, Priene, Miletus and the Temple of Apollo at Didyma.
You can take this journey throughout the year and choose dates that fit your wider travel plans. We take care of selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, three domestic flights, airport transfers and the guided visits included along the way.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Flight to Kayseri & North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text: At 03:45, transfer to Istanbul Airport for your flight to Nevşehir at 06:35. Upon arrival at 08:00, begin a full-day tour of North Cappadocia, visiting Uchisar Castle, Rose Valley, Pasabag, the Zelve Open Air Museum, Devrent Valley, and Three Beauties. Continue to Urgup and Avanos, famous for traditional pottery. Optional visit to a Turkish rug workshop. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia. Visit Uchisar Castle for panoramic views, followed by Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum, famous for fairy chimneys and cave dwellings. After lunch, continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit the charming towns of Urgup and Avanos, known for traditional pottery. After the tour, return to the hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: Flight to Izmir & Kusadasi
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, transfer from Cappadocia to Kayseri Airport for your flight to Izmir.
Upon arrival, transfer to Kusadasi. Rest of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Tour to Ephesus Ancient City
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a guided tour of Ephesus, visiting highlights such as the Odeon, Library of Celsus, Temple of Hadrian, Fountain of Trajan, and the Great Theatre. Continue to the ruins of the Temple of Artemis, followed by lunch and a visit to the House of the Virgin Mary. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Pamukkale & Hierapolis
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces and the ancient city of Hierapolis. Guests may also enjoy swimming at the famous Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, drive back to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Tour to Priene, Miletus & Didymas & Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text: After breakfast, depart for Priene, one of the ancient Ionian cities. Continue to Miletus to explore its impressive theatre and Byzantine fortress, then visit Didyma, home to the magnificent Temple of Apollo and the famous fallen head of Medusa. Transfer to İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport for flight to Istanbul Arrival transfer to hotel. Overnight in Istanbul

itinerary.title: Half day Spice Market & Bosphorus Cruisee
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable cruise along the Bosphorus, sailing between Europe and Asia on one of the world’s most scenic waterways. After the tour, return to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 10-Day Central Turkey Highlights Tour?
faqs.a: The 10-Day Central Turkey Highlights Tour covers Istanbul, Pamukkale, Ephesus, and Cappadocia. You will explore Istanbul's historic landmarks, visit the ancient city of Ephesus, discover Pamukkale's famous white travertine terraces and Hierapolis, and experience the extraordinary landscapes, underground cities, and fairy chimneys of Cappadocia. The tour runs for 9 nights and 10 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 10-Day Central Turkey Highlights Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,995 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, three domestic flights, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees, selected meals, airport transfers, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, hotel category, and availability.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights included in this 10-day itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes three domestic flights. These flights help minimize travel time between destinations and allow you to spend more time exploring Turkey's cultural, historical, and natural attractions.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 9 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels and boutique accommodations with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations near major attractions. All airport and hotel transfers throughout the itinerary are included.

faqs.q: Does the 10-day tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during all scheduled sightseeing tours. As part of the small-group experience, your guide will provide historical insights, cultural background, and local expertise while ensuring a smooth and enjoyable travel experience.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is an excellent choice for first-time visitors who want to experience Turkey's most famous destinations. It combines the country's rich history, remarkable archaeological sites, natural wonders, and unique landscapes into one well-balanced itinerary.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic districts, valleys, and areas with uneven terrain. Ephesus, Pamukkale, and Cappadocia involve moderate walking, but most travelers with average fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: Can I add a hot air balloon ride in Cappadocia?
faqs.a: The Cappadocia hot air balloon ride is not included in the standard package but can be arranged as an optional activity. Since balloon flights are weather-dependent and one of Turkey's most popular experiences, advance reservations are highly recommended.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 10-Day Central Turkey Highlights Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 10-Day Central Turkey Highlights Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can extend your stay in Istanbul, Cappadocia, or the Aegean region, upgrade hotel categories, add optional excursions, or modify the itinerary. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
